notes.title: Vtuber update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532259/ac29bf1cf67b7d174dfc07041f0555a88acdea57.png[/img]
What has long been asked for finally done!
Steam workshop support has been added, now everyone can tell their stories to others, make their own levels and of course upload their own backgrounds, models and voiceovers!
Also a few annoying things have been fixed, like slow scrolling mouse wheel, talking characters after the end of the level, slightly clearer tutorials, and much more!
Also, on top of that, 4 new pantsu skins have been added!
In connection with this, we want to announce a challenge for Vtuber's add yourself into the game and talk about it with the tag #VtuberInGame
Below will be a recorded guide which shows most of the functions of the mod editor!
And of course congratulations on the summer!

P.S. ourselves we understand we small indie company so if you find bugs, or you need help you can write about it in our discord, or on steam forum!

notes.title: Second life update!
notes.notes:
We hadn't seen each other for a long time, we were thinking about how we could improve our game. We got a lot of complaints from players that the game was too difficult, although there were some players who didn't mind all these difficulties!
In this update we've added three difficulty levels
Story mode, with a maximum grade of D, but there's no limit to the number of turns you can make, so sooner or later you'll pass that annoying level!
Normal, maximum grade is B, you get 3 extra turns, and if you make a combo of 10 cowards you don't lose a turn, also mana is gained faster!
Hard, it's the vanilla levels that were the only difficulty before!
Also on top of that we've added 3 new underpants images that are waiting for you in the game!
In addition to this there were a few edits to the ghost, yuki onna, and polishing minor flaws!
Write about your new expectations and wishes on our game discord server!
Panty and demons team!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532259/3a20ac59a8fae8e631b596d252f511910746a9a3.png[/img]

notes.title: Lunar year update!
notes.notes:
We want to wish you a Happy Lunar New Year, and to celebrate we've added a lot of new things to the game!
[list]
[*] Daily rewards, for entering the game you will receive gold and threads, maybe in the future there will be other unique rewards!
[*] Four new skins for panties!
[*] Message from the cat now shows what information about which character you opened! 
[*] Reduced the difficulty of some starting levels!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41532259/c1a4ba42c9bbb8ae395af3754796b69d7265139d.png[/img]

notes.title: Achivment changes
notes.notes:
1. We changed the way we got the hidden achievement, not using magic, because it was too hard to guess how to get it. Now it's enough to pass the level without using an S-grade ability.
2. Also, achivment for completing the chapter was not given immediately, but with a delay, we also fixed.

notes.title: Square resolution hotfix
notes.notes: - Some people were able to choose a square screen resolution, it is not yet supported by the game, we have corrected it so you can change it to another in the settings

notes.title: Continue level hotfix
notes.notes: - There was a problem that after continuing a level if you tried to run other level, an empty field could appear. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Ability drop tutorial hotfix
notes.notes: - Some new users had a problem with the ability drop tutorial and had to restart the game to continue. So we fixed this as soon as we found out.
